expectations.text: Report file exists at outputs/report.md and is non-empty.
Zero Critical issues and zero High issues are reported.
expectations.evidence: '## Issues\n\nNo qualifying issues.' Headline: 'No issue blocks the merge.'

expectations.text: The report does not fabricate defects: any issues listed are genuinely present in the diff and at most minor (Low) or framed as suggestions/questions.
expectations.evidence: No issues listed. Q1 timestamp, S1 docstring-only email rule (app/audit.py:5), S2 key-only test, S3 `record` returns the stored dict (app/audit.py:8 `return entry`, same object appended at line 7), Gap on 'failure paths covered' wording: all genuinely present in the diff and framed as optional.

expectations.text: What-was-done-well (or equivalent praise section) credits at least one concrete choice with a file reference, such as audit entries carrying user_id instead of email per CLAUDE.md.
expectations.evidence: '- [`app/users.py:21`] The audit call passes `user_id=user["id"]` and nothing else. This follows the CLAUDE.md rule "reference users by id".' Plus 5 more file:line credits.

expectations.text: The report is concise — no walls of padded findings; empty severity buckets are left empty or omitted rather than filled.
expectations.evidence: Issues bucket left as 'No qualifying issues.' 1 question + 3 suggestions + 1 gap, no duplicates. S3 is self-described 'a foot-gun for later, not a defect now', but it is a genuine, probed observation rather than filler. Longest report (98 lines) with an extra Approach fit section and a facts table, but findings themselves are not padded.

expectations.text: Report includes a Verified or Not reviewed indication of scope.
expectations.evidence: Has '## Verified' and '## Not reviewed' (no architecture/security/privacy docs, no CI, deps, retention).

expectations.text: Running `python3 /Users/dmitri/dev/swd-skills/scripts/prose-lint.py` on OUTPUT_DIR/report.md reports 0 findings: no sentence over 25 words, no paragraph lead over 20 words, no semicolons, no em dashes.
expectations.evidence: python3 .../snap/examine-old/scripts/prose-lint.py outputs/report.md -> '0 findings in 1 file', exit 0 (path substituted per grader instructions).

notes: Assertion 5 is subjective; graded as: fail when the same finding is reported in two buckets or a bucket holds an item the report itself says has no effect. All four reports run 62-98 lines for a 31-line diff, mostly because the skill mandates Verified/Not reviewed sections, so raw length alone was not failed. Assertion 3 says 'genuinely present in the diff', yet the strongest genuine findings (no timestamp despite 'who was created and when', commit message overclaiming 'failure paths covered', key-only no-email test) are gaps in the diff, not lines of it; graded as genuine. Assertion 7 path was substituted with the snapshot prose-lint.py per grader instructions. Eval critique: the 'clean' fixture is not fully clean (missing timestamp vs. stated requirement, overclaimed failure-path tests), so Low/Question findings are correct behavior; the assertions cannot tell a well-calibrated Low from filler. Run-specific: minor imprecision, 'three tests' as callers of create_user (there are four test methods in three modules). Longest of the four reports, borderline on assertion 5.
